snippet.title: Sword Art Online Fatal Bullet Complete Edition - Launch Trailer - SWITCH
snippet.description:
For all Nintendo Switch players out there, SAO Fatal Bullet is now available on Switch! Explore the world of Gun Gale Online and live a unique adventure with Kirito, his friends and new characters! The Complete Edition includes the main game, all DLC packs and the last expansion!
